basics.name: Sgg Mico
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.headline: A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
basics.summary:
I'm sggmico, a frontend engineer with over 10 years of experience. I've helped build complex systems at major internet companies, with deep, hands-on practice in web architecture, engineering processes, and performance optimization.

I'm fluent in modern frontend stacks and care about code quality and long-term maintainability. I focus on building clear, stable, and easy-to-iterate systems, and I rely on automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD to ensure delivery quality.

Over the past two years, I've focused on Web3, with a solid understanding of blockchain and the Ethereum stack. I have end-to-end smart contract experience, am comfortable with Solidity and ERC standards, and have delivered NFT projects from generation and design through deployment and launch.

I'm also exploring practical uses of AI in development and products, from using large language models to boost engineering efficiency to building AI-assisted tools and workflows. I care about how AI can improve individual and team productivity.

I believe technology should serve people. I value product experience and design, stay active in open source, follow industry trends, and keep learning with curiosity.
